source_read: https://bagelfactory.co.uk/menu/ and the 27 bagel pages /menu/<slug>/ plus the 7 filter pages (all downloaded fresh 2026-10-08; bagelfactory.co.uk robots.txt does not disallow /menu/ or the Ingredient List PDF)
not_verifiable: allergens: none published for this chain (link-only to the chain's Ingredient List PDF, whose names mostly differ from the bagel pages and which leaves the bun out), so there was nothing to compare
notes: Fresh pages re-run through bagel_factory.py reproduce data/source/bagel-factory exactly (items.csv, holdback.csv, chain.csv, allergen_guide.csv; images.csv untouched). Independent read: each saved page rendered in headless Chromium with JavaScript off and its visible 'Nutrition Facts per portion' block parsed with a different regex (comments gone, per-100 g block of Vegan Cream Cheese Stack Mini ignored): all 27 pages (26 published + the held Bacon and Egg) match items.csv on kcal, kJ, fat, saturates, carbs, sugars, fibre, protein and salt. The existing hold-back (Bacon and Egg 589 kcal vs 2062 kJ and macros of about 482 kcal) is still true on the fresh page. Noted only: Cream Cheese and Garlic & Herbs Cream Cheese print identical numbers; The Classic and Tuna Melt print the same protein 33.2 g, fibre 4.1 g and salt 2.6 g.
